messages:
marie: Morning — quick async standup. I merged the AZ redistribution script (PR #382) and deployed config to staging. No blockers on the code side.
ajay: Nice, saw it. Left one comment about instance selection. Will run the e2e in staging and approve if green.
lina: FYI AMS1 spot pool shows unexpected shrink from 20 -> 12 this morning, seeing prewarm backlog spike.
ops-bot: [alert] AMS1 spot pool scale-down detected (maintenance). Details: https://console.cloud/ops/incident/ams1-spot-2026-03-17
tom: We have 8 spare on-demand g4 instances in eu-west-1 that are unused. They're tied to another team but currently free.
ajay: Plan idea — route low-priority prewarm + batch reruns to eu-west-1 on-demand while spot recovers; keep customer-facing workloads pinned to reserved/dedicated.
marie: Agree. I'll add a routing rule. Quick question: who owns the cost delta for that temporary fallback? @finance?
lina: Finance should get a heads-up. I'll ping them after we estimate the delta.
marie: Draft routing patch (apply to routing service):
```
{"policy": "fallback-ams1", "priority": "low", "route_to": "eu-west-1-on-demand", "max_cost_per_token_usd": 0.00015}
```
ajay: That looks good. Also add a TTL so we don't keep spilling after spots recover, e.g., ttl: 30m.
marie: will add ttl. Command I'll run after patch review: `kubectl -n redwood exec svc/router -- curl -XPOST /reload`
ops-bot: Deploy bot: rolling update started for router (deploy/router v2.14.1) — tracking: https://deploys.redwood/release/router/2.14.1
tom: Heads-up: if eu-west-1 on-demand gets saturated we should fall back to warm reserved in us-east-1 (higher latency but cheaper than burst g5).
lina: I'll keep monitoring AMS1 spot pool and post an update here in 30m.
marie: Cool. Blockers: none blocked on me. Today: add ttl, update routing policy, ping finance, and watch the queue.
ajay: I'll finish e2e and approve the PR. If tests fail, I'll post logs here.
sre-bot: Incident reminder: maintenance window in AMS1 ends in ~45m. Automated spot replenishment will retry afterwards.
marie: thanks — closing loop. :thumbsup:
